text.p: Freedom Furniture Ltd said on Tuesday it would make a one-for-17 bonus issue to shareholders.

The record date for the bonus issue, which was announced at the annual general meeting on Tuesday, will be February 17. The company told shareholders at the meeting that its performance in the early stage of 1996/97 (October-September) was in line with forecast. "I am pleased to advise you that our first quarter trading profit is dead on track with where we want to be and at this early stage we expect to achieve our forecast profit for the year," managing director Jonathon Pinshaw said.
"This is in the face of major profit downgrades from several prominent publicly listed retailers, so we are very satisfied with our start to the year," Pinshaw said.

He said Freedom intended to maintain its forecast dividend rate of 7.3 cents per share for the 1997 financial year and planned to open seven stores in 1997, with three already open for business. Two New Zealand stores were under negotiation.

Freedom floated on July 25 last year and achieved a 1995/96 net profit before abnormal items of A$6.2 million which compared with the prospectus forecast of A$5.5 million and the 1994/95 result of A$5.1 million. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
